## Problem or research need
Describe the concrete gap without promoting a hypothesis into an established repository claim.

## Proposed change
Define the smallest useful change and identify whether it affects theory, evidence, implementation mapping, validation, or public metadata.

## Evidence basis
List relevant current repository evidence and external primary sources where applicable.

## Claim and compatibility impact
Identify affected Claim IDs, bilingual surfaces, provenance, or downstream references.

## Acceptance criteria
State observable review criteria and any relevant validation that should actually be performed.

## Non-goals and unresolved questions
Keep unknown or unvalidated state explicit.
